PDF Volume Rendering using the Fourier Projection-Slice Theorem
Abstract The Fourier projection-slice theorem states that the inverse transform of a slice extracted from the frequency domain representation of a volume yields a projection of the volume in a direction perpendicular to the slice. This theorem allows the generation of attenuation-only renderings of volume data in 0 (N2 log N) time for a volume of size N3 • In this paper, we show how more ...
